name: feature-doc
description: > Closed-loop feature documentation for your product. Give it a feature (issue numbers or an id) and it reads the source, drives your live app to capture real screenshots and a screen recording, writes a docs article (Docusaurus or any markdown docs site) with both how-to steps and use-case content, then verifies the article with a fresh-context read-only verifier before reporting. Use when you say "write the doc for <feature>", "document issue #123", or "/feature-doc".
author: huytieu
